versions.changelog:
notestorelab-case-review 1.0.2

- Added explicit documentation of MCP capability surface and available review workflows.
- Clarified local-only, single case root approach; reinforced restriction against treating NoteStore Lab as a hosted platform.
- Updated language throughout for accuracy and clarity regarding product truth and workflow.
- Improved guidance on using review surfaces, workflows, and preferred evidence order.

- Expanded skill guidance to include install and first-success proof steps.
- Added triggers for common Apple Notes recovery and review commands.
- New reference files: install instructions and usage/proof guide.
- Clarified scope to demo-first, local-only, case-root-driven review.
- Included detailed workflow examples and recommended prompt patterns.

Initial release of notestorelab-case-review skill.

- Guides a single bounded NoteStore Lab case review, focused on local, copy-first analysis.
- Emphasizes using derived artifacts over raw evidence and not treating live Notes as a target.
- Provides clear, step-by-step instructions for reviewing and exporting case data.
- Specifies correct terminology and forbidden language to accurately describe the skill’s function and scope.
